// purpose: ts-jest's compiler options: tsconfig.json plus the yauzl pin of tsconfig.typecheck.json. The dev setup links src/node_modules to release/app/node_modules, which holds the older yauzl 2.x types (electron's extract-zip pulls them in); without this the suites that import openPromise (zip import, direct download, database client, transfers) fail to compile. At runtime package.json's moduleNameMapper picks the app's own yauzl.
